audio_role: No music-driven cuts; single unbroken take carried by restaurant room tone and eating sounds. Text joke does the work a trend audio normally would.
can_make: We can make the tabletop: real menu photo of chicken burger on plate with bowls of fries and nuggets, plus an AI-drawn model holding the burger top up in a static medium shot and a 4 s slow push-in started from that photo. We can add the same two-line price text in the edit. We cannot make the eating: our cast never eats, so no bite into the bun, no chew, no picking up and biting a nugget, no mouthful reaction.
core: A guy spends his last dollars on a full fried spread and eats it anyway.
dish: Crispy fried-chicken burger on glossy brioche with curly fries and chicken nuggets on the side
fits: Big handheld fast food meant to be eaten in one bite: fried chicken burgers, smash burgers, loaded fries, nuggets, tenders, onion rings.
hook: White text over the food in second 0-1: Bank account $51.47 vs Food $50.55 while a man lifts the burger top straight to his mouth.
needs_camera: A real person in a real busy restaurant actually biting, chewing and swallowing, shifting from burger to nugget in one continuous take, with real background diners and real food gloss and crunch.
people: One young man in his 20s with brown hair, dark green overshirt over black t-shirt, watch on left wrist, sitting at the table facing camera; he lifts the burger top with both hands, bites it, chews looking at camera, then reaches with right hand for a nugget and eats it.

shots.action: man lifts burger top bun, takes a bite, chews, then picks up a nugget and bites it
shots.framing: medium eye level from across table, man chest-up with full spread in foreground

why_it_works: You see a real bite and chew, glossy bun and craggy fried chicken up close, and a full table of fries and nuggets. The price text makes it a relatable splurge, so you watch him eat and imagine the crunch and salt yourself.
